cc:Work.dc:title: Cost per round and qubits used
cc:Work.dc:description: Bars of two-qubit gates per round at Helios today and a future device: C4-Helix adaptive 54 and 45, Carbon-Helix full 560 (120 level 1, 200 level 2, 240 level 3 outer), Carbon-Helix R8 216 and 170. Below, peak physical qubits: 52 for C4-Helix and 92 for Carbon-Helix, under Helios's 98.
